description: Estimate the net cash a Singapore property seller takes home: sale price minus Seller's Stamp Duty, legal fees, outstanding mortgage, CPF refund with accrued interest, and agent commission. Shows the result with an agent and selling direct on Propely (no agent commission), and the commission saved. From Propely (propely.sg), the owner-direct condo marketplace in Singapore. Indicative figures, not legal or financial advice.

commissionPercent.description: Agent commission as a percent of the sale price

cpfInterest.description: CPF accrued interest if known; omit to estimate at 2.5% p.a. in Singapore dollars (SGD)

cpfPrincipal.description: CPF principal used for the property, to be refunded in Singapore dollars (SGD)

gstOnCommission.description: Add 9% GST on the agent commission

legalFees.description: Conveyancing legal fees in Singapore dollars (SGD)

outstandingMortgage.description: Outstanding home loan to be repaid on completion in Singapore dollars (SGD)

purchaseDate.description: Date the property was purchased, as YYYY-MM-DD

saleDate.description: Intended date of sale (must be after purchaseDate), as YYYY-MM-DD

salePrice.description: Expected sale price in Singapore dollars (SGD)

name: calculate_seller_net_proceeds
title: Singapore seller net proceeds
